state:
**Side goal `narrow-a-readonly-property`: stage 2 is closed, and stages 3 and 4 are untouched.**
E0782 refuses every `readonly` write the checker can see (`crates/nvs-types/src/expr/assign.rs`, `reject_readonly_write`; `crates/nvs-types/src/ctor_init.rs`, `InitState::write`), and E0843 refuses a hook on `readonly`.
The writes it cannot see now throw at run time. `ClassDesc` carries one `readonly` bit per field slot (`ClassDesc::field_is_readonly`, filled by `ClassTable::set_readonly_fields`). The bit is decided in `nvs_types::layout` (`ClassLayout::readonly_fields`), carried by `nvs_ir::ir::Class::readonly_fields`, and set by codegen only for a class with at least one `readonly` slot. `write_erased_property` throws `cannot modify \`readonly\` property \`C::$v\`` (a `RuntimeError`) before the store, which covers `object` receivers, `$obj->$key` and `Core\Reflect\ClassInfo::set`. The graph decoder writes through `NvsObj::set_field` and is unaffected. Case: `tests/conformance/class/an-erased-write-to-a-readonly-property-throws.nvst`.
No rule names the run-time check yet: `rule:classes/lateinit-restrictions` is the nearest home, and stage 4's rule work should state "`readonly` is written once" with both halves.
In this worktree the `extension` step of `bun nv verify` fails because `@types/node` is not installed, and `nvs-cli`'s `live_config` test fails under load and passes alone. Neither is this goal's.
